hooks.command: jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:\"Open items live in Linear, team TEC. List the ones on your plate before anything else and lead your first message with them. Then read your charter and handoff at .claude/agents/<you>/.\"}}"

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+(HEAD:)?main([[:space:]]|$)|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*:main([[:space:]]|$)"; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Pushing to main is forbidden by the Rules of Engagement in CLAUDE.md. Every change goes through a pull request. Push your branch and open one.\"}}"; fi

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "supabase[[:space:]]+migration[[:space:]]+repair"; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"migration repair rewrites the database's own record of what was applied. The gap it would close is deliberate — migration 20260908235234 is withheld because it contains personal data. See supabase/README.md.\"}}"; fi

jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"ask\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Opening a pull request, updating a branch and merging each wait for Joel's click. Joel settled this on 2026-09-23 after an instruction to prepare was read as permission to act.\"}}"
